featureMaster.title: Feature Master
featureMaster.subtitle: Every permission this company has registered. Templates are built from these.
featureMaster.emptyBody: Register the ones this company uses and they become available to every template.

activate.title: Activate feature?
activate.body: It becomes assignable to templates again, and anyone holding a template that already includes it regains access.

deactivate.title: Deactivate feature?
deactivate.body: Access to it is revoked everywhere at once, including for templates that already include it. Nothing is deleted - reactivate to restore.

bulkRegister.title: Register features
bulkRegister.subtitle: Pick what this company uses. Registering again later never duplicates or reactivates anything.

templateMaster.title: Template Master
templateMaster.subtitle: Reusable permission bundles. Everything a role or user can do comes from these.

fields.name: Template name
fields.templateKeyHelp: Generated from the name when the template is created, and kept even if you rename it.

activate.title: Activate template?
activate.body: Anyone it is assigned to regains everything it grants.

deactivate.title: Deactivate template?
deactivate.body: Everyone holding it loses what it grants. Nothing is deleted - reactivate to restore.

templateMaster.emptyBody: Create one, add features to it, then assign it to a role or a user.

quickCreate.title: Quick create module templates
quickCreate.subtitle: Create a ready-made template per module, pre-filled with that module's features.
quickCreate.none: Every module already has a template.

quickAdd.notAvailable: This template's name doesn't match a module, so there's nothing to quick-add.
quickAdd.allAssigned: Every {{module}} feature is already on this template.

featuresToTemplate.title: Features to Template
featuresToTemplate.subtitle: Choose which features each template grants.

templatesToTemplate.title: Templates to Template
templatesToTemplate.subtitle: Let one template include another's features. Included templates are resolved recursively.
templatesToTemplate.heading: Included templates
templatesToTemplate.empty: This template doesn't include any others.

userTemplates.title: Templates to User
userTemplates.subtitle: Grant a template straight to one person, on top of whatever their roles give them.
userTemplates.heading: Assigned templates
userTemplates.empty: No templates assigned. This user only has what their roles grant.
userTemplates.bulkAssignHint: Select two or more users to assign in bulk

roleTemplates.title: Templates to Role
roleTemplates.subtitle: Everything a role grants comes from the templates attached here.
roleTemplates.heading: Assigned templates
roleTemplates.empty: No templates attached. This role grants nothing yet.

bulkAssign.title: Bulk assign templates
bulkAssign.noUsersBody: Go back and select the users you want to assign templates to.

transfer.inheritedHint: Comes from an included template - remove it there, not here.

effectiveFeatures.title: Effective features
effectiveFeatures.subtitle: Everything this template grants - its own features plus everything it inherits.

errors.cycle: That would create a circular reference between templates.
